name: Olives (Kalamata)
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in SIBO as they are low FODMAP and fermented. High sodium content may affect some individuals.
preparationTips: Rinse before eating to reduce excess sodium if desired
Remove pits carefully to avoid choking hazard
Store opened jars in refrigerator and use within 2-3 weeks
Pat dry with paper towels when adding to salads to prevent excess liquid
